title: Charlie’s Chalk Dust | SALTS | Sorbet 60ml
description:
Charlie’s Chalk Dust | SALTS | Sorbet 60ml
Sorbet:
Escape the heat with Italian ice sorbet. Enjoy tart raspberries mixed with the sour of lemonade. These tastes mix together to make a deliciously satisfying e-juice. Don’t miss out! Sorbet by Pachamama Subohm Salts.
